question: In April 2025, the Indian government signed a Headquarters Agreement with which intergovernmental wildlife organisation to establish its headquarters in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**International Big Cat Alliance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Government of India** officially signed the **Headquarters Agreement (HQA)** with the **International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA)** in **April 2025**, formalizing the establishment of its global permanent secretariat in **India**.
 
• The **IBCA** is an **intergovernmental organization** launched to create a global platform for the protection and conservation of the world's major big cat species and their habitats.
 
• In **February 2024**, the Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**, approved the establishment of the alliance with a focus on **96 range countries**.
